verdict.rationale: Inngest explicitly documents durable agent loops with per-step checkpointing that survive crashes mid-run (docs-21: 'if the process dies at step 7 of 12, the agent picks up at step 7'), a dedicated agent-tool-loop guide (docs-23) implementing ReAct-style Reason/Act/Observe loops as durable retriable steps, and step.ai.wrap() (docs-22) to wrap model calls (OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI SDK) as memoized, retried, observable steps — directly matching the story of checkpointed model/tool calls surviving crashes. This is backed by core durable-execution primitives (retries, memoization, step-level fault tolerance) in docs-2/15/16 and corroborated by independent community reports of reliability in production use. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically of an agent loop surviving a mid-run crash (community evidence is about general job/queue reliability, not agent loops specifically).
